paragraphs.heading: The temptation to be right
paragraphs.edited: But it's also really easy, after you've been through all of this, to have so much knowledge crammed into your head. And yet, instead of sharing that with love, sometimes we get caught up in trying to be right. Sometimes we get caught up in trying to get notches in our spiritual belt. paragraphs.heading: Relationships, not conversions
paragraphs.edited: Okay, so the last thing. We talk about love because love is what builds relationships. Please remember that it is so important to build relationships. Make sure your students understand that this is not about getting conversions — this is about building relationships. Jesus said to his disciples that it's by your love and by the way you treat one another that they'll know that you are my disciples, and that they'll know who I am. The way in which we love other people is how some people are only ever going to see Jesus. Don't focus on the conversions. Focus on the relationships, and focus on the ways in which we can love others.
